title: nasturtium cardamine
intro: Nasturtium cardamine, commonly known as Cardamine concatenata or Penn State-weed, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Brassicaceae. The plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to treat colds and sore throats due to its antimicrobial properties and rich content of vitamin C. The therapeutic actions of Cardamine concatenata include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe and protect the skin from damage. Bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
